model.description: His look. `body` picks his model slots from `bodies` and `head` picks his head from `heads`, with `hood` false switching to the head's `hoodless` model. `advisor` (body and head) is the vanilla campaign Advisor moved onto humanoid01 by generators.advisor_overhaul_model. The other bodies are vanilla humanoid01 outfits kept for later per-weapon armour. A weapon's own `body` picks its body, falling back to `body` here. `jade` is the Jade Wizard's old, long-bearded head.
model.head: advisor
model.prop_offsets_description: Weapon model -> [x, y, z] metres its model is moved in its own axes (x runs along the blade). Positive x slides the weapon blade first, so his hand sits further down the grip. Each one is written as a copy under the mod's props folder and used in place of the vanilla weapon. Set from the dashboard's Adjust panel.
model.hand_shift_description: [x, y, z] metres his hand and finger vertices move, in the right hand bone's bind frame (z flips for the left hand). Fitted against the vanilla Empire Captain so his fist closes around a weapon grip. Set from the dashboard's Adjust panel.

portrait.description: His 2D portrait art and his 3D portrait camera. `source` is the vanilla Advisor bust (pack, path) every image is cut from. `porthole` places it on the 300x164 porthole image and `card` on the 60x130 unit card (and the 120x260 info picture at twice the size), bottom aligned over a top-to-bottom gradient. `camera_head` replaces the head camera of the Grey Wizard's portrait settings: `z` is the distance and `y` the height above the head bone, in metres.

staff_and_sword.name: Staff and Sword
staff_and_sword.description: A walking staff for his spells and a plain Imperial blade for anything that gets too close.

missile.description: His staff bolt, a plain arcane bolt for now. Its element is meant to follow his first lore later, so the key names no element. `template` is the vanilla Hag Witch's staff bolt, with one bolt per shot instead of two, and `projectile` replacing the template's values. `ammo` is a little under the Hag Witch's 28.

upgrade.description: Bursting Bolts, the Staff apex reward. Five weaker bolts per shot instead of one, each bursting in a wide blue blast that spares his own side. The blast is the Blue Scribes' blue flame burst, as wide as the Poison Wind Mortar's blast and pushing harder, without its Warpflame.

art_1.name: Spellguard
art_1.description: He is slow and he is soft, and he has made his peace with both. The wards take what the staff cannot turn.

art_2.name: Focused Bolt
art_2.description: He stops throwing the Winds and starts aiming them.

art_3.name: Long Reach
art_3.description: Every step he takes is slow, so he makes every step count from further away.

art_4.name: Wind Blast
art_4.description: When they reach him anyway, the staff throws them back where they came from.

army_1.name: Hedge Wards
army_1.description: Small charms on every banner pole.

army_2.name: Screen the Staff
army_2.description: He cannot outrun anything, so they learn to stand where he cannot be reached.

army_3.name: Woven Wards
army_3.description: He threads a ward through every rank before the first blow.

apex.name: Channelled Staff
apex.description: The staff drinks the Winds and gives them back to him, five bolts at a time.

army_4.name: Charged Steel
army_4.description: Before the lines meet he walks along them and touches every blade.

sword_and_shield.name: Sword and Shield
sword_and_shield.description: He leaves the staff behind and takes up a knight's shield.

art_1.name: Shield Wall
art_1.description: He stands where the blows land thickest and lets them come.

art_2.name: Turn the Arrow
art_2.description: He has watched too many men die to arrows to let it happen to him.

art_3.name: Iron Body
art_3.description: He was never quick. He learned to be hard to kill instead.

art_4.name: Bulwark
art_4.description: He does not move, and nothing moves him.

army_1.name: Hold the Line
army_1.description: Men stand firm next to a man who will not step back.

army_2.name: Shields Up
army_2.description: He calls the volley before the archers loose.

army_3.name: Shield Wall
army_3.description: Every shield overlaps the next, the way he showed them.

apex.name: Shield of Faith
apex.description: Not his god's faith. His own, that this time will be different.

army_4.name: Guardian
army_4.description: Whoever stands behind him is out of reach. He has made sure of it in every world that ended.

sword_and_bow.name: Sword and Bow
sword_and_bow.description: A huntsman's blade and a hunting bow. He was a fair shot long before he was a wizard, and he has not forgotten.

missile.description: His bow. `template` is the vanilla missile weapon whose missile_weapons and projectiles rows are copied (the Huntsmarshal's arrow), with `projectile` replacing the template's values. `ammo` is the vanilla Ulrika's hero bow ammo.

art_1.name: Steady Draw
art_1.description: He breathes out, and the arrow goes where he looked.

art_2.name: Long Eye
art_2.description: He sees the shot before he takes it.

art_3.name: Full Quiver
art_3.description: He never runs out. He planned for this.

art_4.name: Quick Hands
art_4.description: Draw, loose, draw, loose, faster than thought.

army_1.name: Huntsmen
army_1.description: He shows the archers where to aim.

army_2.name: Marked Ground
army_2.description: Every stone and stake is a range marker to him.

army_3.name: From the Trees
army_3.description: He knows where the enemy will walk, because he has watched them walk there before.

apex.name: Hail of Doom
apex.description: One arrow that splits into a storm.

army_4.name: Quick Hands
army_4.description: Nock, draw, loose. He counts it out until they no longer need him to.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.description: A two-handed Imperial greatsword, heavier than any wizard should carry. He swings it well enough.

art_1.name: Overhand
art_1.description: A blow from above, with all of him behind it.

art_2.name: Wide Arc
art_2.description: He stopped aiming at one man a long time ago.

art_3.name: Cleaving Arc
art_3.description: One swing, three men. He has done the sums.

art_4.name: Headsman
art_4.description: Every man in the arc gets the same chance. None of them like it.

army_1.name: Bloody Drill
army_1.description: He makes them practise until they stop flinching.

army_2.name: Charge Them
army_2.description: He goes first. They follow, and they keep swinging.

army_3.name: Through the Plate
army_3.description: He teaches them where the armour is thinnest.

apex.name: Whirl of Steel
apex.description: He stops choosing targets and lets the blade go round.

army_4.name: Butcher's Bill
army_4.description: He knows what this battle will cost and pays it early.

glaive.name: Glaive
glaive.description: A long Cathayan glaive made to cut a horse out from under its rider, and a short sword at his hip for when the line closes.

art_1.name: Long Guard
art_1.description: He holds the point out where a horse would have to run onto it.

art_2.name: Horse Cutter
art_2.description: The blade was made for one job: rider and horse, one stroke.

art_3.name: Turning Blade
art_3.description: The heavy head keeps moving after the cut, and so does he.

art_4.name: Through the Barding
art_4.description: He finds the gap in a war beast's armour on the first try.

army_1.name: Line Drill
army_1.description: Shoulder to shoulder, points out, until they stop flinching at hooves.

army_2.name: Wall of Blades
army_2.description: He spaces them so no charge finds a gap.

army_3.name: Hold the Line
army_3.description: He has seen this charge before, in a war nobody else remembers. It breaks.

army_4.name: Long Arms
army_4.description: He teaches every unit to strike first and from further away.

apex.name: Ten Thousand Blades
apex.description: The glaive line that stopped an empire's cavalry, as he remembers it.

iron_hand.name: Iron Hand
iron_hand.description: No weapon at all. Open hands, a stance like a city wall, and the weight of the forge behind every blow, the way Zhao Ming fights before he takes his dragon form.

dragon.name: Dragon Form
dragon.description: He lets the old shape take him: iron scales, a forge-hot breath, wings over the field. The Iron Dragon of Cathay, as he remembers it.

human.name: Human Form
human.description: He folds the dragon away and stands as a man again, open hands and an unbending stance.

art_1.name: Iron Skin
art_1.description: Blows ring off him like a hammer off an anvil.

art_2.name: Forge Palm
art_2.description: An open hand that lands with the weight of a falling ingot.

art_3.name: Unbending
art_3.description: He takes the hit and does not move a step.

art_4.name: Hammer Hands
art_4.description: Each strike falls like the smith's hammer, steady and without end.

army_1.name: Foundry Drill
army_1.description: He works them like iron, heat and blow, until the line holds its shape.

army_2.name: Tempered Ranks
army_2.description: Quenched and hardened, they wear their armour like a second skin.

army_3.name: The Great Bastion
army_3.description: Where he stands, the line stands like the wall in the north.

army_4.name: Cast in Iron
army_4.description: He teaches them to take a blow the way metal takes the hammer.

apex.name: Heart of the Forge
apex.description: The iron Zhao Ming carries, as he remembers it.

foot.name: On Foot
foot.description: He walks, as he always has.

warhorse.name: Barded Warhorse
warhorse.description: An armoured Imperial charger, steady under spellfire.

pegasus.name: Imperial Pegasus
pegasus.description: A winged Imperial steed that lifts him over the battle line.

disc.name: Disc of Tzeentch
disc.description: A floating daemon-disc, bound to him by a bargain he does not talk about.

arts_art_1.name: Art I: Stance
arts_art_1.description: The first thing he learned with every weapon he ever held, in every world that ended.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_2.name: Art II: Edge
arts_art_2.description: He has fought this fight before. His hands remember how it went.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_3.name: Art III: Flow
arts_art_3.description: The weapon stops being a tool and starts being an argument.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_art_4.name: Art IV: Ending
arts_art_4.description: How he finished it last time. And the time before that.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_1.name: Army I: Drill
arts_army_1.description: Soldiers near him pick up his habits without knowing they have.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_2.name: Army II: Formation
arts_army_2.description: He places men where he once saw them live.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_3.name: Army III: Last Stand
arts_army_3.description: He has seen how armies break. He does not let this one.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_apex.name: Master of Arms
arts_apex.description: Every weapon he has ever held, in every ending, answers him at once.\\n\\nLocks the other Apexes and the Polymath.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

magic_reserves.name: Deep Reserves
magic_reserves.description: He has learned to hold more of the Winds than a body should.

magic_steady.name: Steady Hands
magic_steady.description: He miscast once, at the worst possible moment, and the world ended a little early.

magic_archmage.name: Archmage
magic_archmage.description: Every lore he ever learned, in every world, answers him now.\\n\\nEach turn his army gains one random cataclysm spell, a memory of how some world ended.\\n\\nLocks the other Apexes and the Polymath.

martial_0.name: Assassinate
martial_0.description: He knows which of them will matter later. He settles it now.

martial_1.name: Wound
martial_1.description: Not a killing blow. A reminder.

martial_2.name: Assassinate Lord
martial_2.description: Generals die too. He has watched it happen in every ending.

martial_3.name: Damage Walls
martial_3.description: Every wall falls eventually. He only hurries it along.

martial_4.name: Assault Garrison
martial_4.description: He walks in through the gate they forgot to watch.

martial_5.name: Damage Building
martial_5.description: A fire in the right storehouse ends a siege early.

martial_6.name: Block Army
martial_6.description: A cut rope, a spooked horse, a missing quartermaster.

martial_7.name: Hinder Replenishment
martial_7.description: Their wounded do not come back to the line.

martial_9.name: Assault Units
martial_9.description: The whole camp, the same night.

civic_0.name: Scouting
civic_0.description: He knows where they are. He usually knows where they will be.

civic_1.name: Training
civic_1.description: He trains them for the war after this one.

civic_2.name: Replenish Troops
civic_2.description: He finds men to fill the gaps. He knows where they hide.

civic_3.name: Increase Mobility
civic_3.description: He knows the shortcut. He has walked it in three other lives.

civic_4.name: Scavenge
civic_4.description: Nothing on a battlefield is wasted while he is there.

civic_5.name: Spread Public Order
civic_5.description: He reminds the people what the alternative looks like.

civic_6.name: Cleanse Corruption
civic_6.description: He has seen what the taint becomes. He burns it out early.

civic_7.name: Stimulate Growth
civic_7.description: He remembers which years the crops failed, and plants for them.

civic_8.name: Increase Trade
civic_8.description: He knows which roads will close, and which ships will sink.

civic_9.name: Boost Income
civic_9.description: Half the counting-houses in the Empire owe him money from a life they cannot remember.

civic_10.name: Steal Technology
civic_10.description: He has read books that have not been written yet. Theirs are easier.

martial_apex.name: The Last Sword
martial_apex.description: At the end of one world he was the last one standing. He intends to be again.\\n\\nLocks the other Apexes and the Polymath.

civic_apex.name: Power Behind Thrones
civic_apex.description: Kings come and go. He has advised most of them, in one world or another.\\n\\nLocks the other Apexes and the Polymath.

actions_default.name: Default Actions
actions_default.description: The hero actions he always has: Scouting, Scout Settlement and Boost Income.

memory_seen_the_end.name: Seen the End
memory_seen_the_end.description: He has watched this army walk into this ambush before. Not this time.

memory_old_lessons.name: Old Lessons
memory_old_lessons.description: Everything he teaches, he learned the hard way. Several times.

memory_calm_voice.name: Calm Voice
memory_calm_voice.description: Men stand firm around someone who is not afraid. He stopped being afraid a long time ago.

memory_weight_of_years.name: The Weight of Years
memory_weight_of_years.description: He has died before. He did not care for it, and he takes more killing now.

memory_every_mistake.name: Every Mistake Already Made
memory_every_mistake.description: There is no error left for him to make. He made them all in other lives.

memory_polymath.name: Everything, Again
memory_polymath.description: He has been a swordsman, a sorcerer, a spy and a steward, in one ending or another. This time he will be all of them.\\n\\nThe Polymath. It grows with each discipline (Arts, Memory, Magic, Hero work) in which he has 3 skills. Locks every Apex.

memory_long_patience.name: The Long Patience
memory_long_patience.description: He has all the time in the world. He has had it before.

memory_end_fire.name: The Ending of Fire
memory_end_fire.description: The sky burned for nine days and he watched it from the last tower. His blade remembers the heat.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_end_plague.name: The Ending of Plague
memory_end_plague.description: The cities emptied quietly. He learned what a slow death tastes like.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_end_silence.name: The Ending of Silence
memory_end_silence.description: Nobody screamed. The army simply stopped arriving. He keeps his own march quiet now.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_end_drowning.name: The Ending of Drowning
memory_end_drowning.description: The sea came in over the walls. He held a shield above his head for a long time.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

memory_end_hunger.name: The Ending of Hunger
memory_end_hunger.description: The granaries were empty before the first battle. He remembers what was worth taking.\\n\\nLocks the other Endings.

magic_focus.name: Spellweaver's Focus
magic_focus.description: Every ending, the first thing he learned was to hold one thought steady while the world shook.

magic_recitation.name: Quick Recitation
magic_recitation.description: The words come faster each time. He has said them in every tongue that ever ended.

magic_warded_mind.name: Warded Mind
magic_warded_mind.description: He has been unmade by sorcery before. He remembers the shape of the hole.

magic_channel.name: Open Channel
magic_channel.description: The Winds find him now. They have learned where he stands.

magic_overcast.name: Overcast Discipline
magic_overcast.description: Anyone can pour more power in. He knows when to stop.

magic_arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
magic_arcane_ward.description: A thin shimmer, taught to him by a mage whose name no one else recalls.

magic_battle_caster.name: Spell and Steel
magic_battle_caster.description: He casts with one hand and cuts with the other, and has never found the two work apart.

arts_gate.name: A Style of His Own
arts_gate.description: Seven teachers, seven endings, and he took the best of each. What comes out is nobody's but his.

combat_sleeves.name: Ironbound Sleeves
combat_sleeves.description: Leather, steel, and a lesson from a swordsman who did not live to see the sequel.

combat_wards.name: Duelling Wards
combat_wards.description: A flick of the wrist and the blade glances aside. He has practised it on worse than swords.

combat_steel_weave.name: Steel in the Weave
combat_steel_weave.description: Every cut carries a little of the spell that guided it.

combat_blade_winds.name: Blade of the Winds
combat_blade_winds.description: At the end of one world the Winds themselves held his sword arm. He remembers the grip.

combat_veteran_hide.name: Veteran's Hide
combat_veteran_hide.description: Scar over scar over scar. Little finds soft skin to bite.

combat_unbroken.name: Unbroken
combat_unbroken.description: He has been the last man standing. It taught him how to be the first one back up.

combat_aim.name: Practised Aim
combat_aim.description: He has loosed arrows at the end of every kind of world. The hand knows where to go.

combat_piercing.name: Piercing Shot
combat_piercing.description: Aim for the buckle. The buckle is where armour ends.

combat_long_sight.name: Long Sight
combat_long_sight.description: A target seen sooner is a target already lost.

combat_deep_quiver.name: Deep Quiver
combat_deep_quiver.description: The last arrow is always the one he saved for himself. He stopped saving it.

combat_storm_needles.name: Storm of Needles
combat_storm_needles.description: One shot, then a hundred, then the sky goes dark with them.

magic_quiet_mind.name: Quiet Mind
magic_quiet_mind.description: The Winds come easier to a mind with no fear left in it.

magic_second_wind.name: Second Wind
magic_second_wind.description: Just when the pool runs dry, he finds another cup behind it.

magic_well_remembers.name: The Well Remembers
magic_well_remembers.description: He has drunk from this well in lives that never were. The well recalls him kindly.

magic_cadence.name: Steady Cadence
magic_cadence.description: The same words, the same breath, every time. The Winds learn to expect it.

magic_conduit.name: Conduit Unbound
magic_conduit.description: He stopped asking the Winds for power. Now he simply lets them through.

magic_wider.name: Wider Weave
magic_wider.description: He learned to let the thread spread before it settles.

magic_sharper.name: Sharper Weave
magic_sharper.description: And then to pull it tight, to a point.

magic_beyond_sight.name: Weave Beyond Sight
magic_beyond_sight.description: There is a pattern behind the pattern. He has seen it from the far side.

hero_pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
hero_pathfinder.description: He has walked this road in four endings. It never got shorter by itself.

hero_forager.name: Forager's Eye
hero_forager.description: Where others see scrub, he sees supper.

hero_hand_pocket.name: A Hand in Every Pocket
hero_hand_pocket.description: Every door in the world has a friend on the inside, and he has met all of them.

hero_banner.name: The Banner Remembered
hero_banner.description: A banner remembered is a banner that does not fall. Every army he has ever stood with fights harder for it.

hero_lamp.name: The Lamp in the Window
hero_lamp.description: Wherever he rests, someone leaves a light on. He has never asked them to.

combat_barrier.name: Shell of Light
combat_barrier.description: A thin shimmer of the Winds holds in front of him.

combat_barrier_mend.name: Mended Shell
combat_barrier_mend.description: A broken shell is a lesson. He has learned to stitch it faster.

magic_ruinous.name: Hex of Misfire
magic_ruinous.description: He knows exactly how a spell goes wrong, because he has watched it go wrong.

magic_standing_conduit.name: Arcane Conduit
magic_standing_conduit.description: The Winds do not rush through him anymore. They wait in him, patient, like water in a cistern.

combat_shell_aura.name: Warden of the Shell
combat_shell_aura.description: Where he stands, broken shells knit again. The men near him feel it before they understand it.

corruption_chs.name: Spread Chaos Corruption
corruption_chs.description: He has watched Chaos corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_kho.name: Spread Khorne Corruption
corruption_kho.description: He has watched Khorne corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_nur.name: Spread Nurgle Corruption
corruption_nur.description: He has watched Nurgle corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_sla.name: Spread Slaanesh Corruption
corruption_sla.description: He has watched Slaanesh corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_tze.name: Spread Tzeentch Corruption
corruption_tze.description: He has watched Tzeentch corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_skv.name: Spread Skaven Corruption
corruption_skv.description: He has watched Skaven corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_vmp.name: Spread Vampiric Corruption
corruption_vmp.description: He has watched Vampiric corruption eat a world. He knows exactly where to plant it.

corruption_final.name: A Corrupting Presence
corruption_final.description: Three kinds of rot are not enough.

corruption_lead.name: The Taint Remembered
corruption_lead.description: He has walked through every kind of ruin there is. He can still smell the corruption in each.

combat_momentum.name: Weight of the Charge
combat_momentum.description: He learned to charge from a knight who rode into the last sunset of a dying world.

combat_long_breath.name: The Long Breath
combat_long_breath.description: He has fought for days at the end of the world. One afternoon does not tire him.

combat_mending.name: Flesh Remembers
combat_mending.description: His body has healed from worse, many times. It still knows how.

hero_students.name: Students in Every Court
hero_students.description: Half the captains of the world once sat at his table and listened.

combat_barrier_line.name: Light Along the Line
combat_barrier_line.description: He has learned to stretch the shimmer thin, across every rank that stands with him.

arts_army_4.name: Army IV: Every Banner
arts_army_4.description: Every army he ever marched with left him one trick. He hands them all on.\\n\\nWhat it does follows the weapon in his hands. Use Change Loadout to see the new effects.

arts_army_gate.name: A Host of His Own
arts_army_gate.description: The men around him fight the way he taught them, whatever he holds.

wh_main_lore_fire.name: Lore of Fire
wh_main_lore_fire.description: Aqshy, the first Wind he ever felt. It burned his hands then too.

wh_dlc03_lore_beasts.name: Lore of Beasts
wh_dlc03_lore_beasts.description: Ghur, learned from a beastmaster in a world where men had lost.

wh_main_lore_metal.name: Lore of Metal
wh_main_lore_metal.description: Chamon, the patient lore of things that last. Nothing lasted.

wh_main_lore_heavens.name: Lore of the Heavens
wh_main_lore_heavens.description: Azyr. He read the stars that fell on the last night.

wh_main_lore_light.name: Lore of Light
wh_main_lore_light.description: Hysh, kept burning in a temple after every other light went out.

wh_dlc05_lore_life.name: Lore of Life
wh_dlc05_lore_life.description: Ghyran. He grew a garden on a dead world, just to see if he could.

wh_dlc05_lore_shadows.name: Lore of Shadows
wh_dlc05_lore_shadows.description: Ulgu, the lore of not being where the end is looking.

wh_main_lore_death.name: Lore of Death
wh_main_lore_death.description: Shyish. He has more right to this lore than any Amethyst magister alive.

wh2_main_lore_high_magic.name: High Magic
wh2_main_lore_high_magic.description: Qhaysh, taught by an elf who outlived her island by a hundred years.

wh3_main_lore_of_ice.name: Lore of Ice
wh3_main_lore_of_ice.description: The cold that came after the fires, in a world that ended slowly.

wh3_main_lore_of_tempest.name: Lore of Tempest
wh3_main_lore_of_tempest.description: Storms he walked through for a century to reach the next ending.

wh3_main_lore_of_yang.name: Lore of Yang
wh3_main_lore_of_yang.description: Half a truth from Cathay. The other half is the next skill.

wh3_main_lore_of_yin.name: Lore of Yin
wh3_main_lore_of_yin.description: The other half. He has never managed to hold both at once. Yet.

wh3_dlc27_lore_mists.name: Lore of Mists
wh3_dlc27_lore_mists.description: Sea-fog spells from a coast that sank.

wh3_dlc24_lore_hag.name: Lore of the Hag
wh3_dlc24_lore_hag.description: Old witch-craft from the far north, bought at a price he still pays.

wh2_main_lore_dark_magic.name: Dark Magic
wh2_main_lore_dark_magic.description: Dhar, drawn raw. He knows exactly how dangerous it is. He used it anyway.

wh_main_lore_vampires.name: Lore of Vampires
wh_main_lore_vampires.description: Taught by a count who wanted a friend for the long dark.

wh3_dlc29_lore_undeath.name: Lore of Undeath
wh3_dlc29_lore_undeath.description: The Great Necromancer's own words, from a world where he won.

wh2_dlc09_lore_nehekhara.name: Lore of Nehekhara
wh2_dlc09_lore_nehekhara.description: Incantations a liche priest taught him in exchange for a name.

wh2_dlc11_lore_deep.name: Lore of the Deep
wh2_dlc11_lore_deep.description: Drowned magic, from a fleet that sailed off the end of the world.

wh_main_lore_big_waaagh.name: Big Waaagh!
wh_main_lore_big_waaagh.description: It should not work for a man. It works for him. He does not know why.

wh_main_lore_lil_waaagh.name: Little Waaagh!
wh_main_lore_lil_waaagh.description: Goblin magic, learned by losing a lot of card games.

wh3_dlc23_lore_hashut.name: Lore of Hashut
wh3_dlc23_lore_hashut.description: Fire and slavery, from the furnace-priests of a world they burned.

wh2_main_lore_ruin.name: Lore of Ruin
wh2_main_lore_ruin.description: Warp lightning. He has seen what is left when the Horned Rat wins.

wh2_main_lore_plague.name: Lore of Plague
wh2_main_lore_plague.description: He caught it once. He got better. Nobody else did.

wh2_dlc14_lore_stealth.name: Lore of Stealth
wh2_dlc14_lore_stealth.description: The Eshin sorcerers' tricks, learned by being their target for a decade.

wh3_main_lore_nurgle.name: Lore of Nurgle
wh3_main_lore_nurgle.description: Grandfather's kindness. He refused it, and kept the spells.

wh3_main_lore_slaanesh.name: Lore of Slaanesh
wh3_main_lore_slaanesh.description: He refused this one too. It was harder.

wh3_main_lore_of_great_maw.name: Lore of the Great Maw
wh3_main_lore_of_great_maw.description: Gut-magic from the Ogre camps, earned by eating what they ate.

wh_dlc03_lore_wild.name: Lore of the Wild
wh_dlc03_lore_wild.description: The herdstone songs. He sang them at the end, when there was no one left to hear.

wh2_dlc17_lore_rune.name: Lore of Runes
wh2_dlc17_lore_rune.description: A runesmith taught him three runes before the last hold fell. He worked out the rest.

polymath_1.name: Everything, Again (1 of 4)
polymath_1.description: He draws on 1 of his disciplines at once.

polymath_2.name: Everything, Again (2 of 4)
polymath_2.description: He draws on 2 of his disciplines at once.

polymath_3.name: Everything, Again (3 of 4)
polymath_3.description: He draws on 3 of his disciplines at once.

polymath_4.name: Everything, Again (4 of 4)
polymath_4.description: He draws on 4 of his disciplines at once.

advisor_overhaul_effect_army_barrier.text: Barrier: %+n for all units in the army except characters

advisor_overhaul_effect_staff_bolt_burst.text: "Bursting Bolts" (each staff shot fires five bolts that burst in a wide blue blast, sparing his own side)
